timeline.title: Academic writing exemplar and cross-client routing V1
timeline.summary: Added a generic evidence-first protocol, REQUIRED/AUTO/SKIP routing, read-scope rules, article and section maps, own-evidence-first drafting, anti-copying boundaries, and Codex/Web parity checks.

timeline.summary: Added source-rule mapping, story relevance and academic-increment audits, reproducibility-preserving section rules, conservative redundancy lint, three-line-table and no-manual-break contracts, figure/table and fact ledgers, and copy-paste Web instructions.
